description: Estimate a season's size and calendar: total round-robin fixtures, games per match day (limited by courts, one slot per day), match days needed, every match-day date from start_date at a fixed interval, and the finish date. Use for "when will the season end?". Do NOT use for pairings (use round_robin_schedule) or one day's timetable (use match_day_plan).

courts.description: Courts usable at the same time on each match day, integer 1-12; caps games per match day. E.g. 2

days_between_rounds.description: Days between consecutive match days, integer 1-60. Default 7 (weekly)

second_leg.description: If true, plan a double round-robin (each pair meets twice). Default false

slot_minutes.description: Length of one game slot in minutes, integer 10-180 (validated and echoed in the note; each match day is one slot). E.g. 30

teams.description: Team names: 2-100 unique, non-empty names (trimmed), e.g. ["Falcons", "Tigers", "Bears"]

name: season_plan

dates.description: Every match-day date, YYYY-MM-DD, in order

finish_date.description: Date of the last match day, YYYY-MM-DD

games_per_round.description: Games played per match day: min(floor(teams/2), courts)

games_total.description: Total fixtures in the season (n(n-1)/2 per leg)

note.description: Plain-English summary of the season plan and assumptions

per_team_games.description: Games each team plays over the season

rounds_needed.description: Number of match days needed to play all fixtures

title: Season plan
